recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Treat any future changes to the current external/community/implementation links as a new navigation issue rather than as delayed FHIR-11439 work.
issue_request: FHIR-11439 was a Published FHIR-core index-page issue from the DSTU2 ballot, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to move the FHIR Foundation link under the other external support links and add a Support heading. The final resolution states that the link had already been moved.
initial_application: No repository commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-11439 was found. Git history shows commit 119ead8b36e393da3e11930e72bbfc2bf05151f3 had already changed source/index.html from Quick Links to External Links and placed a bold FHIR Foundation link with related community/support links in that area before the Jira was created.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists source/index.html as the Home page, confirming current build scope. The current source/index.html External Links section has Implementation Guides, FHIR Community, and Implementation Links columns; later FHIR-50904 history retitled the old Foundation area and split support-oriented implementer links. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later evidence requiring the old label or a separate Support heading to be restored.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change is needed because the current authoritative home page is not in the misplaced-link state described by FHIR-11439, and reintroducing a Support heading now would be a broader navigation redesign rather than applying this already-resolved non-substantive issue.

related_jiras.note: Later cleanup of source/index.html retitled the old FHIR Foundation section as FHIR Community and split support-oriented implementer links.
